request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; ongoing maintenance and user support for 52 weeks
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node upgrades, wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, platform support, release engineering, security and dependency maintenance
Compatible stable Daedalus release at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support in a stable release
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation in Daedalus with documentation and interoperability verification
Japanese localisation and Japanese-language user support throughout the contract period
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc., with administration and disbursement through Intersect
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Daedalus Wallet maintenance and improvements for 2026-2027 as a time and materials engagement.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the true count asserted to be meaningfully higher.
All funded outputs, including source code, build tooling, documentation, and release artifacts, will be public assets under the Apache 2.0 license.

Se7en Labs assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The team has operated under an IOG contract for Daedalus maintenance since January 2026, closing August 31, 2026, and has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

The proposal commits to maintaining Daedalus compatibility with upcoming protocol changes, including hard forks, Leios, Peras, and Nested Transactions, with stable releases at least 2 weeks before mainnet activation.
Release-timing and version-currency success metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

The budget allocates 1,666,667 ADA to labor, 33,333 ADA to test hardware, 33,333 ADA to financial audit, and 52,000 ADA to the Intersect administration fee, with unspent labor, hardware, and audit funds returned to the treasury.

Intersect will administer funds, verify milestones, authorize monthly disbursements against verified work, and use treasury management smart contracts with external oversight entities listed in the proposal.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for a one-year Daedalus maintenance and improvement engagement by Se7en Labs, administered through Intersect, covering protocol compatibility, release engineering, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation and support, and an architecture assessment.
